title: Filter Restaurants by Vegan Friendly, Price and Distance
description: Filter a list of restaurants based on vegan-friendly status, max price, and max distance, then sort by rating (desc) and ID (desc).
pseudocode:
1. filtered = restaurants.filter(r => (veganFriendly ? r.vegan : true) && r.price <= maxPrice && r.dist <= maxDistance)
2. filtered.sort((a, b) => b.rating - a.rating || b.id - a.id)
3. return filtered.map(r => r.id)

steps.note: Initial restaurants: [[1, 4, 1, 40, 10], [2, 8, 0, 50, 5], [3, 8, 1, 30, 3]]. Filtering for veganFriendly=1, maxPrice=50, maxDist=10.
Filtered list: [[1, 4, 1, 40, 10], [3, 8, 1, 30, 3]]. (Restaurant 2 excluded as it is not vegan).
